properties.description: Phase 7 PR 2. Served where a call is received (ReflowService::call_tool), when no hub's view is named and the design is not served from a registry: search_design with tracked_designs loads each pinned design's committed export into a fresh in-memory, read-only, non-reaching design and merges the hits in the hub view's shape; a read aimed at a pinned design (member, or a '<graph_id>:' id) runs on that export alone; a write aimed at one is refused.
properties.name: service/tracked.rs — a design that pins others searches and reads them from their committed exports (tracked_designs; reads aimed by member or prefix)
